intent_en: To illustrate the massive scale of the Vision Fund relative to other major venture capital firms.
previous_intent: To illustrate the massive scale of the Vision Fund relative to other major venture capital firms and its primary focus on investing in technology companies.
narration_support: The Vision Fund makes even Goldman Sachs look more bronze than gold.
chart_support: Horizontal bar chart showing the Vision Fund is significantly larger than other VC funds.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly compares the Vision Fund's size to Goldman Sachs and other firms to put it in perspective, while the chart visualizes this disparity with a much longer bar for the Vision Fund compared to the other VC funds.
